terbaru.judul: Condensation and optimal targeting of repeated forcing in heterogeneous networks
terbaru.pelajaran: We study how concentrating such forcing on important entry nodes, with seeding probability $π_i\propto w_i^γ$, changes the size of the resulting cascades in a stochastic SIR model on bipartite networks.

terbaru.judul: Energy-fed commitment: a minimal model of random selection followed by reinforcement
terbaru.pelajaran: We study a minimal stochastic model of what can then make that choice progressively harder to undo.

terbaru.judul: Noise-driven loss of chimera states and bifurcations in a nonlocal oscillator ring
terbaru.pelajaran: We study this transition in a nonlocally coupled Kuramoto--Sakaguchi ring with a cosine kernel using the nonlinear Fokker--Planck equation.

terbaru.judul: Low-Dimensional Reduction of Mean-Field Coupled Dynamical Systems with Units Described by Two Real Variables: Classification and Applications
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that low-dimensional reduction is possible for a broad class of populations of limit-cycle oscillators, extending the previously reported reducible class of populations of Stuart-Landau oscillators to include many new models.

terbaru.judul: Multifractality of human upper-limb velocity tracks motor optimization via hand dominance experiment
terbaru.pelajaran: Theoretical goal-directed movements follow a unique, stereotyped velocity profile, but continuous movement has no unique optimal solution, so it is unclear whether motor optimization makes continuous movement more stereotyped or more diverse.

terbaru.judul: Affective Valence as the Interoceptive Rate of Change of Jacobian Scale
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes that valence is the rate at which interoception moves a self-sustaining system's responsiveness relative to its terminal set (roughly, death).

terbaru.judul: Twitching fiberboids in the collective : A table-top, one-dimensional, active particle gas
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we show using thermally driven nylon fibers on a slightly curved glass surface, that fiberboids also come in another state, that we call ``twitching'': the fiber rolls for a short time and then switches direction, implementing on large scales a diffusion-like motion.

terbaru.judul: Fractal forcing of turbulence by settling particles
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work we present the first fully-resolved observations of the turbulence induced by large particle structures, also known as cluster-induced-turbulence (CIT), obtained through particle-resolved direct numerical simulations at high volume fractions and density ratios in large domains.

terbaru.judul: Negative partisanship drives anti-frontrunner volatility in election dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that cross-candidate rejection sensitivity triggers a non-smooth collapse of abstention, dividing the phase space into an under-mobilized regime and a fully mobilized campaign regime.

terbaru.judul: Increased-Order Generalized Synchronization in Memristive Neurons: Analytical and Data-Driven Approaches
terbaru.pelajaran: We investigate increased-order generalized synchronization between four- and five-dimensional memristive Hindmarsh--Rose neurons, focusing on the selection and stabilization of the synchronization map.
